description: Dependency policy enforced by scripts/check-dependencies.mjs (pnpm deps:check, part of pnpm security, pnpm verify and CI). See docs/security.md#dependency-policy. Changing this file is a reviewed decision (CODEOWNERS).

installSettings.description: What pnpm-workspace.yaml must keep, so weakening the supply-chain settings fails the gate instead of passing unnoticed: the release delay (minutes, at least), the trust policy and the refusal of transitive dependencies from outside the registry.

elkjs.reason: Graph layout used by Prisma Studio inside the prisma CLI (the migration image). Used unmodified; EPL-2.0 obligations apply only to modifications of elkjs itself.

releaseSets.description: Packages published together as one release that work only at the same version (scripts/check-dependencies.mjs, checkReleaseSets): the members the workspace uses directly must resolve to one version in pnpm-lock.yaml, so an update that moves one alone fails here. Dependabot proposes each set in a group of its own (.github/dependabot.yml). A set that matches no direct dependency fails too.

prisma.reason: Prisma releases the three as one version: `prisma generate` writes apps/api/src/prisma/generated stamped with the CLI's version and engine, for the runtime that @prisma/client ships, and the driver adapter implements that runtime's interface.

sources.description: Every package must come from the registry with a sha512 integrity hash. List here, with a reason, a package that must come from a git repository or a tarball URL.
